title: Closure Notice and Settlement Terms of the Bluegate Business Storage Account
content:
The Bluegate Business Storage Account terms fix, per program, the written notice a business gives to close its account, whether the account balance must be paid before closure, and what happens to the business-billed agreements on closure.

| Program | Calendar days of written notice to close | Balance must be paid before closure | Business-billed agreements on closure |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Essentials | 10 | Yes | Moved to standard individual billing |
| Bluegate Business Plus | 10 | Yes | Moved to standard individual billing |
| Bluegate Business Pro | 30 | Yes | Moved to standard individual billing |
| Bluegate Business Logistics | 30 | Yes | Moved to standard individual billing |
| Bluegate Business Fleet | 30 | Yes | Moved to standard individual billing |
| Bluegate Business National Account | 60 | Yes | Moved to standard individual billing |

**Terms common to all programs.** On every program the account balance must be paid before closure, and on every program the business-billed agreements move to standard individual billing when the account closes. Only the notice period differs: 10 calendar days on Essentials and Plus, 30 on Pro, Logistics and Fleet, and 60 on National Account.

*Hypothetical reading:* a Bluegate Business Fleet account gives notice of 30 calendar days; a Bluegate Business National Account gives notice of 60.
